title: TextFragment
description: A contiguous run of text belonging to exactly one ContentNode. Fragments are the join between logical structure and physical location: a node spanning two pages has (at least) two fragments, each with its own PhysicalLocator; a page holding parts of several nodes holds one fragment per node.

ordinal.description: 0-based order of this fragment within its node.

after.description: Separator that follows this fragment when concatenating node text (mirrors Text-Fabric's 'after' feature).

charStart.description: Start offset of this fragment within the node's concatenated plain text.
